topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The rain's been coming down like it's got a grudge, and the only light in this whole damn city seems to be the neon flicker of memories, none of them good. Got a call today, a teacher, you’d figure they’d be used to kids screwing up, but this was different. A former student, sent her a gift, something more than a card, more than flowers. Something that made her hands shake, made her eyes dart the room like a spooked bird. She didn’t say why, but it’s the unsaid that gets you every time. You start to wonder, in this town, what kind of past could come back to drop a package at your doorstep, and more importantly, what’s in the package. I told her I’d look into it, keep it on the down-low. But down here, in the shadows where the real deals get done, you can’t trust a damn thing, not even gifts.
